title: GTA 6 console sales: Newzoo says it rescues 2026
description: GTA 6 console sales are set to rescue a weak 2026, says Newzoo analyst Emmanuel Rosier, with PC and GTA Online the long-term question, per PC Gamer.

body.text: GTA 6 console sales are expected to save what has otherwise been a dull year for console gaming, according to a new forecast from market analysts Newzoo, reported by PC Gamer. Newzoo's director of market intelligence, Emmanuel Rosier, says the console market would probably have shrunk year-over-year in 2026 without the game. Instead, its launch should bring in billions of dollars and give spending a clear lift.
Why GTA 6 console sales matter so much in 2026

PC Gamer frames the backdrop plainly: consoles cost more than ever, and even players who can afford the hardware have less money left for games. Rosier adds that Western console has been losing ground for a while.

items: Western console's share of global games revenue slipped from 21.5% in 2015 to 17.1% in 2025.
Its revenue has been broadly flat since 2021.
The Western console player base has been flat since 2022, because most people who want a console already own one.

body.text: Against that, Newzoo predicts GTA 6 will push console full-game spending up by 17.5% this year. The firm forecasts Western console to be worth $36.3 billion in 2026.
GTA 6 PC release date: what the report says

Rosier is careful to say the initial impact will sit mostly in Western console. The longer-term story, in his view, depends on PC and online play. That matters for Indian players who game on PC, since the report points out that PC is far bigger than console in several major markets, including China.

No PC date has been announced. PC Gamer notes that tradition would suggest a wait of roughly a year and a half after the console launch. It also argues that weak console momentum and the value of GTA Online could shorten that gap. A recent GamesBeat report claims the game will arrive in early 2027, but treat that as a report rather than a confirmation.
GTA Online could widen the audience

Rosier calls the online mode a key unknown. Depending on how Rockstar positions and monetises it, he says, it could expand the audience significantly. A model with lower barriers to entry could open up players well beyond the traditional Western console crowd.

Newzoo's data offers some context. At least 37% of players who preordered GTA 6 have spent money on GTA Online, but only 15% did so in the last 12 months. PC Gamer reads that as a sign the mode needs a refresh. Rockstar hasn't confirmed anything, though Twitch's CEO has said the multiplayer component will be out in 2027.

Keep an eye out for any official word from Rockstar on a PC version and on how GTA Online will be priced and structured. Those two answers will decide whether GTA 6's impact stays inside Western console or spreads to bigger audiences, including in India. Until then, the 2027 timelines are reports and claims, not announcements.

faqs.q: How much will GTA 6 boost console spending in 2026?
faqs.a: According to PC Gamer, Newzoo predicts GTA 6 will lift console full-game spending by 17.5% this year. Newzoo's Emmanuel Rosier says that without it, the console market would likely be down year-over-year in 2026.

faqs.q: When is the GTA 6 PC release date?
faqs.a: No PC date is confirmed in the report. PC Gamer notes that tradition suggests a gap of roughly a year and a half after the console launch, though a GamesBeat report claims the game will be out in early 2027.

faqs.q: Is GTA Online coming with GTA 6?
faqs.a: Rockstar hasn't confirmed anything, according to PC Gamer. Twitch's CEO has said GTA 6's multiplayer component will arrive in 2027.
